about: SCION 33 trace, measured from the render: x_screen/y_screen are the dog silhouette centroid (px, in that frame camera), facing is measured on screen (head left of centroid = +1, toward the door), x_score is the rig root in world metres (= the score x mapping, 1 m = 1 m).
camera: two fixed set-ups, one cut at 20.5 s (A: wide, B: closer on the sill); x_world_measured back-projects the measured centroid through that frame camera onto the plane of the path

onsets_measured.measure: dog centroid moves right (away from the door) > 1.5 px from its 0.9 s position
head rises on screen: head y > 2 px above its lowest point of the retreat (1.4-2.2 s)
muzzle direction on screen turns > 10 deg from its 3.3 s heading (the head leads the turn)
head right of the body centroid (facing measured -1)
head lifts > 2 px off the paws (from its 7.3 s rest)
the rump (right edge of the silhouette) moves left, toward the door, > 1.5 px from its 14.5 s hold (the head lowering from 14.42 s moves the centroid first, so the centroid is not used here)
silhouette top drops > 3 px below its 23.6 s height
muzzle direction on screen turns > 8 deg or head rises > 2 px from its 26.2 s pose
head drops > 3 px below its look-in height after 27.8 s

end_pose.reading: nose inside the inner face of the wall, body centre outside the sill edge, tail on the porch
